rootCause: The Kafka listener consumes with cpf.batch.remote.kafka.consumer-group, while CpfKafkaConsumerControlAdapter searches for cpf.batch.worker.group-id and defaults to cpf-batch-worker. The real remote Worker container is therefore never found, so admission control records BAT_WORKER_BROKER_CONTROL_APPLY_FAILED and drain/resume cannot affect the actual distributed listener.
impact: Worker readiness remains degraded even while registration SQL succeeds
Operational drain and resume do not control the actual remote Worker consumer
A drain test can stall or accept new work contrary to policy
requiredClosure: Bind the provider control adapter to the canonical remote consumer-group owner
Keep an explicit override for non-Batch messaging consumers
Add exact real-property and missing-group fail-closed regressions
Replay drain/resume against two actual Kafka Workers
